description: Offre de transport de la C.A. Beaune Côte & Sud (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Beaune Côte et Sud. List of stops, timetables and bus routes of the Côte & Bus urban and peri-urban network circulating on the territory of the Communauté d'Agglomération Beaune Côte & Sud. On-Demand Transportation (ODT) is not included. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Beaune Côte et Sud. The portal shows the English title as "Transportation offer of the C.A. Beaune Côte & Sud (GTFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Beaune Côte et Sud. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GTFS-RT, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
